translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Tegin Jesús Olivo-yalzhe nad.
Tegin te pangin neg-oiposgu, Jesús kannan Pabzhe-koled-negzhe nonibal. Tegin tulemal-ichejul Jesúszhe irmanonimal. Tegin Jesús chigwiszhun Pab-igalbal tulemal-oturdagal.

Tegin Jesús tulemal-oturdajiidgin, Moisés-igalgin-tulemal-oturdamalad tegin Pariseomal Jesúszhe ome-cheinonimal. Imi we ome machered-pidbak yosgu-kunai-taklejadbal tulemal we ome-kasmal. Tegin Pariseomal neg-abalgin ome-okwisnonimal.
Tegin Pariseomal Jesúsga chogalmal: —Tule-oturdaked, imi anmal we ome-kasmaldo, machered-pidbak yosgu-kunai.
Tenal Moisés anmalga igal-mezhisdo, ome-machered-pidbak-yosgu-kunai-taklejal, akwagin sagyeal tar-mejo. ¿Imi pedin, pe igi chogmójun, we ome-mesgal ib-nued o chul? Tenal Jesús ilgwen yakir pes.

Tenal Pariseomaldin yami Jesús-wilub-taknonimal, Jesús igi ega chogdago-dewa. Tenal Jesús istar chogzhal, we tummagan igal-nika Jesús-kagal. Tegin Pariseomal Jesúsga omegin chunmasgu, Jesús ilgwen tullu-chigwis. Tegin Jesús kogin nap-nermakalzhun.
Tenal Pariseomal kannan-kannan Jesúszhe ekisnaigualmal, Jesúsde igi ome-imako. Tegin Jesús kannan inniki chignonibalgu, Pariseomalga chogal: —Imi tule-iskued-nikchulid-inzhel we omegin akwa meto.
Tegin Jesús kannan tullu-chigwisbalgu, kannan kogin nap-nermakalbal.

Tegin tulemal Jesús-chogzhad itosmalgu, tulemal-ome-tuktinanimalad-wal-walgwen aknimai-kual. Kepegin chelegan-inzhel nadmal, tegin te-cholbal machimal-chapingana aknidmalmojun. Tenal Jesús omebak apinni pes.
Tegin Jesús tullu-chiid kannan inniki chigwisgu, omeje ekichialzhun: —Ome, ¿pia naddé, tulemal-pe-tuktinanimaladdé? ¿Pegin kwen chogzhajul-kus, pe sapejul oturdaleged-wilub?

Tegin ome Jesúsga chogal: —Chulá, Tummad. Tegin Jesús omega chogalzhun: —An-pela, an pegin kwen chogojul-kuo, pe sapejul oturdalegenab. Imisgin pe akalzhul pe nejunno. Tenal pe melle iskuedgin pal nanao.)
Jesús igal-napírragwad otalononikid

Tegin Jesús tulemalga chogalbal: —Imi antin tule-iti-napkin-pukmaladga kallen neg-otalonaidyob igal-chunchunnad otalononi, tule igi naneenabmal. Tenal tule anpak kudiil, wisgunoniko tule igi tullenoniko, tule neg-taledgin pel-kwapa mag immal taknonikidyob. Tenal tule neg-chichidgin kudiidyob, we tule immal-kwen-wichulidgin pal kwen nanaojul-kuo.
Tegin Pariseomal Jesúsga chogalmalzhun: —Imi pe aga tukin pe chunmajima. Al pe-chogzhad ibga keg pel ku.

Tegin Jesús Pariseomalga chogal: “Chulá. Imi an naga tukin chunmajiilen, wedin ampa anka iwen-kwen-akalzhulin. ¿Ibiga an teob chog? Imi antin, an wisdo, an pia-akar tani. Tegin an wisbaldo, an piaje nebal. Tenal pemal an-kwen-wichulmal, an pia-akar tani. Tegin pemal an-kwen-wichulmalbal, an piaje nebal.

Tenal pemal pinche askin tuleyob pinzhemal. Tenal pe tulegin chogmal: ‘We tule, tule-nued.’ Tegin pemal chogmalbal: ‘We tule, tule-iskana.’ Tenal antin tulegin kwen chogzhul wedin tule-nued o tule-iskana.

“Tenal an tulemalgin chogbielen, tule-nued o tule-iskana, wedin anka iwen-kwen-akalzhulin. Tenal antin walgwen immal kwen chogzhul. Tenal Pab-an-palmialid an-chogedyob ampa chogmo-choggu, al an-immal-chogzhad wedin ib-chunchunnaddo.
“Tenal pemal-igal-mamikid chogdo, tule-walbogid immal takchal, tenal yopí chogzhamalal, wedin ib-napírra.
Tenal antin naga tukin chunmajii, tegin Pab-an-palmialid ampa an-yopí chunmajimo. Al an-chogzhaddin, ib-chunchunnaddo.”

Tegin Pariseomal Jesúsga chogalmalzhun: —¿Teobí? ¿Imi pia pe-pabdéjun? Tegin Jesús Pariseomalga chogal: —An-pela, pe aku an-takmal, an igi pinzhe. ¿An-Pab pulzhun, pe igi wisguo? Imi pe an-nued-wisguelen, pe an-Pab-wisgumalmogan. Pitogua.
Tenal teun Jesús Pabzhe-koled-neggin tule-mani-ukmalad-neg-yabal tulemal-oturdadi-kus. Tenal Jesús ampa e-kaleged-wilub omojul-choggu, al tulemal Jesús-kwen-kaszhul-kusmal.
Jesús chogzhagujad, Judio-tummagan e-kwen-wichulid
Tegin Jesús Judio-tummaganga kannan chogalbal: —Imi antin, an ne, tenal pemal an-amialmalal, an-kwen-onogojul-kuo. Tenal pemal aka aga iskuedgin purkwemalo. Tenal an-naoedzhe, pe kwen togojul-kumalo.
Al Judio-tummagan aga emal-emal ekichialmal: —¿Tegil we tulede, aga tukin mesnedé? ¿Imi anmal naga tukin mesnejulmal-choggu, al we tule chogyé anmal e-naoedzhe kwen togojul-kuo?
Tegin Jesús Judio-tummaganga chogalbal: —Tenal pemal iti-napkinmalad, tenal antin nikpa-neggined. Tenal pemal nikpa-negginmalad-chul, tenal antin iti-napkined-chulmo.
Al an pemalga chogzhado: ‘Pemal iskued-nikadgin ampa purkwenemal.’ ¿Ibiga an teob chog? Imi an pemalga chogzhiidgin pe ibzhejulil an toa-tule, pemal aka aga iskuedgin purkwenemal.
Tegin Judio-tummagan Jesúsga chogalmal: —¿Tegil pe toa-tulejun? Tegin Jesús tule-tummaganga chogalzhun: —Imi an kepe-sagla-akar an pemalga chognonido, an a-tule.
Tenal pemal-noal-tiidbal, an pemalgin ichejul immal-choged nika. Tenal tule-an-palmialid napírra immal chog. Tenal tule-an-palmialidbal an turdajadbal, an tule-iti-napkin-pukmaladga chunmanoni.
Tenal Judio-tummagan aku itosmal, Jesúsde e-Pabgin chunmadii.

Tegin Jesús tule-tummaganga chogalzhun: —Imi pemal nikpa an-Te-Tule-Chunna-onakwijal, kep pe wisgunonimalo, ante toa-tule. Tenal an naga-itoleged, walgwen immal kwen imajul. Tenal an Pabbal-immal-turdajadbal, an chunmadii.
Tenal tule-an-palmialid anpak mes kudii. Tenal an-Pab-peiedbal an Pabga keg-chulgu immal ima-choggu, al an-Pab walgwen an-kwen-ebejul.
Tenal Jesús ampa chunmanaidgin, tulemal-ichejul Jesúsgin ibzhenonimal.
Judio-tummagan Jesúsgin-ibzhejulidbal mag taklenonimal niazhikmalad
Tegin Jesús Judio-egin-ibzhenonimaladga chogalzhun: —Imi pemal pane-pane an-chogzhad-pallí kudimalal, pemal anpal-turdamalad-chunchunnadga kunonimalo.
Tegin pemal igal-chunchunnad wisgunonimalbalo. Tegin pemal mag itononimalbalo, pe iskuedgin ololgusmal.

Tegin Judiomal Jesúsga chogalmal: —Anmal, Abraham-e-wagwagan. Tenal anmal tule-pimaladzhe kwen kalesgudijulmal tule-anmal-kasmalad-peiedyob immal imagal. Tenal pedin chogdo, anmal kalejad-akar kep nonemal. Pe kakanma.

Tegin Jesús Judiomalga chogal: —Tenal antin chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: imi tule iskuedgin kudiil, wedin chogledo, we tule iskuedgin kalesgudii. Tenal tule pane-pane iskuedginbi kudii-choggu, al we tule keg iskuedgin no.
Imi tule-pinche-arpaged igal-kwen-nikchul, tule-neg-ibed-e-kwenadga kugal. Tenal tule-neg-ibed-e-machi igal-nika, ilagwen-nadgu neg-ibed-e-kwenadga kugal.
Imi Pab-Machi iskuedgin pe-ololchenonikil, pe chunchunnad ololgunoniko.
Tenal an wisdo, pemal Abraham-e-wagwagan, tenal pemal an-chogzhad kwen abingejulidbal, pemal yabli an-mesbimal.
Tenal an Pab-waglik-immal-takchadbal, an chunmadido. Tenal pemal, pe-pab-itojadbal immal imamal.

Tegin Judiomal Jesúsga chogalmal: —Imi an-tad, Abraham. ¿Tede an igi akaldé? Tegin Jesús Judiomalga chogal: —Imi pemal Abraham-e-wagwa-chunchunnadilen, pemal Abraham-immal-imajad-pallí, pe immal imadimogan.

Imidin pemal Abrahamyob immal kwen imaszhulmal. Tenal an Pab-Tummadgin-turdajadbal an pemalga chunchunnad chogzhado. Imi antin tule-nued, tenal pemal yabli igal-aminanimal an-mesgal. Tenal Abraham pemalyob kwen pinzhaszhul-kus.

Tenal pemal, pe-pab-Satanás istar immal imaked-yopí, pemal tamalmo. Tegin Judiomal Jesúsga chogalmal: —Tenal anmal neg-chichidgined-tulejulmal; anmal-pab-chunchunnad, Pab Tummad. Tenal pe melle anmalgin chogdago, nia-Satanás anmal-pab.

Tegin Jesús Judiomalga chogal: “Imi Pab Tummad pemal-pab-chunchunnadilen, pemal pela-pela an-pilalmalan. Imi antin Pab-akar noni, iti-napche. Al an wegin mai. Tenal an naga-itolegedbal kwen nonijul, tenal Pab Tummad an-palminoni.
¿Imi an-pemalga-chunmajad, ibiga pe mag itojulmal pe ebinzhe? Imi pemal Pab-Tummad-nuskan chul-choggu, al pe aku-itomaldo an-chunmajad.

“Tenal nia-sagla pe-pab-choggu, al pe niazhikidmalmo. Tenal nia-sagla igi peídin, pemal teob nanemalmo. Tenal nia-sagla kepe-sagla-akar tule-mes. Tegin nia-sagla keg inniki chunmabal, keg-chulgu kakanzhaal chunmada. Tenal nia-sagla tule-kakanzheed-e-sagla-choggu, al nia-sagla chunmakalil, kusgu e-taedbal kakanzhealda, keg inniki chunmada.
“Tenal antin, pemalga inniki chunma-choggu, al pe ankin kwen ibzhejulmal.
¿Imi pemal-walgwen, toa ankin chogo, an immal akalos? Chulá. ¿Imi an chunchunnad chunmanaidbal, tede ibiga pe keg anpal ibzhemalzhun? Tenal pemal ankin ibzheed-wilubmalan.
“Tenal tule-Pab-Tummadzhikiddin, Pab-Tummad-chunmaked mag ito. Tenal pemal Pab-Tummadzhikidzhulmalad-choggu, al pemal Pab-Tummad-chunmaked mag kwen itojulmal.”
Jesús chogzhagujad ede Pab-Machi

Tegin Judiomal Jesúsga chogalmal: —Imi pe anmalgin chogzha-choggu anmal niazhikmalad, al anmal nabir pegin chogzhado, pedin tule-iskana, anmal-Samaritano-tule-takedyob. Tegin anmal nabir pegin chogzhabal pedin nia-nika.
Tenal Jesús Judiomalga chogalzhun: —Chulá. Antin, an nia-kwen-nikchul. Tenal antin, an-Pab-nug otummonai. Tenal pemal an-nug izhonanimal.
Tenal antin naga tukin nug-onudanaichul. Tenal tule-pid an-nug-onudanai, tenal we tule nabir chogo, an tule-nued o chul.
Tenal an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: imi meke-ibi-tule an-chogzhad-pallí tael, we tule purkwed kwen itogojul-kuo.

Tegin Judio-tummagan Jesúsga chogalmal: —Imi pe-immal-chogzhadbal anmal nued wismaldo, pedin nia-nika. Imi anmal-tad-Abraham purkwis, tegin Pab-kaka-palchogmalad purkwismalmo. Tenal pedin chog: ‘Tule an-chogzhad-pallí tael, purkwed kwen itogojul-kuo.’
¿Tede igijun? ¿Imi pede anmal-tad-Abrahamga pul pe tule-tummadzhí? Imi anmal-tad-Abraham purkwis, tegin Pab-kaka-palchogmalad purkwismalmo. ¿Tegil pe toa-tulejun?
Tegin Jesús Judio-tummaganga chogalbal: “Imi antin, an naga tukin okannoelen, wedin anka ibga keg pel kuoen. Tenal an-Pab an-nug-okanno. Tenal pemal chogmal, an-Pab pemal-Pab-Tummadga mai.

“Tenal pemal aku Pab-Tummad-takmal. Tenal antin, an naga mag Pab-tak. Imi an chogzhalen an Pab-kwen-wichul, an pemalyob kakanzhenaimogan. Tenal antin, an Pab-Tummad-wisdo. Tegin an Pab-chogzhad-pallí nanegwisbal.
Teun pe-tad-Abraham weligwal an-itosdo, an tanikoedgin. Tegin Abraham an-tanikoed-takchadbal, aga ulubgin weligwal-itononibal.”
Tegin Judio-tummagan Jesúsga chogalmalzhun: —Imi pe pirka-tulabo-kakaambe pel nikchuli, ¿tede pede Abraham-takchadé? Chulá.
Tegin Jesús Judio-tummaganga chogal: —Imi an chunchunnad pemalga chogdo: Abraham ampayo mimmilegeddu, antin pato tetuel kudii.
Tegin Judio-tummagan Jesús-chogzhad itosmalgu, akwa chualmal, akwagin Jesús-mesgal. Tenal Jesús Pabzhe-koled-neggin aga tukin otukcha. Tegin Jesús te-cholbal Pabzhe-koled-neg-akar nodzhun.
